name: Generate campaign content for four personas
description: Generate and persist guarded campaign content for four personas. Personas are processed one at a time with a 15-second cooldown. Production also requires N8N_CONCURRENCY_PRODUCTION_LIMIT=1 so overlapping campaigns cannot exceed Gemini quota. This repository export is intentionally inactive and must be smoke-tested before publishing.

parameters.content:
### Gemini rate-limit safety

- Repository export stays **inactive**.
- One persona per loop iteration.
- Wait 15 seconds before the next persona.
- No model retry and no schema-fixer model call.
- HTTP enrichment/persistence may retry at most 3 times.
- A Gemini 429/quota error returns retryable HTTP 503.
- Before publishing, set `N8N_CONCURRENCY_PRODUCTION_LIMIT=1`; otherwise overlapping campaigns can still burst.

Do not publish until a one-campaign smoke test is approved.
